purpose: B4V4 compact final judge proof-tail strengthening probe
scope: short model-build probe only; not a long exact closure run
change: slot-task/slot-arc time pruning enabled for B4V4 compact pricing profile; V4 proof phase can use a current column-pool JourneyColumn as a HiGHS MIP-start solver hint
basis: If slot * min_active_sortie_duration + shortest depot-to-task travel exceeds task latest service start, that task cannot be served in that slot. If earliest slot/source arrival plus service plus source-target travel misses the target latest service start, that task-task arc cannot be used in that slot.

restricted_region_bound_ledger_enhanceme.certificate_boundary: Even if all listed restricted/no-good regions have nonnegative best-known bounds, they remain diagnostic unless a complete full-space partition and coverage proof is available.

required_task_set_region_pricing.search_space: all compact single-journey route variants whose task set is exactly the requested required_task_set
required_task_set_region_pricing.certificate_boundary: Can certify a single exact task-set region only; cannot claim full-space no-negative or BPC_TREE_OPTIMAL by itself.

required_task_set_partition_probe.exact_regions: one required_task_set pricing solve per unique harvested task set
required_task_set_partition_probe.residual_region: one restricted residual pricing solve forbidding all harvested exact task sets
required_task_set_partition_probe.certificate_boundary: The runner can report a complete no-negative partition candidate, but official_certificate_allowed and can_claim_certificate remain false until final judge/certificate ledger integration consumes it.

certificate_boundary: This pruning removes only time-bound infeasible slot-task placements. MIP start is only a primal solver hint. No restricted/no-good result or warm-start telemetry is promoted to no-negative certificate.
